resources.string: Record voice notes right on your phone: ideas, out-loud thoughts and reminders to yourself. Recordings stay on this device only.
Tap “Record” and say everything you want to remember. The note stays on your phone.
The recording and its audio file will be deleted from your phone and cannot be restored.
A voice note can’t be recorded without microphone permission. You can enable it in the app settings.
Recording failed. Check that the microphone is not busy in another app and try again.
Could not play the recording: the file may be damaged or deleted.
